svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Trend gauge (live) (obc-gauge-trend, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Instruments. Box 288x192 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value (default 0, read): Process value _pn_min (default 0, read): Scale minimum _pn_max (default 100, read): Scale maximum _ps_unit (default '', read): Engineering unit _pn_points (default 60, read): Points kept in the live buffer (60 points at 1 s = last minute) _pn_interval (default 1, read): Sampling interval of the live buffer, seconds _pb_hasSetpoint (default false, read): Show the setpoint marker _pn_setpoint (default 0, read): Setpoint (shown when _pb_hasSetpoint is true) _pb_off (default false, read): Instrument off (greyed out)
